sourceVisualNotes: Actual source icons show a silver pointed purple-jewel mask/helm, elongated pink flower, rainbow daisy, plain orange basketball, white-blue football and red winged heart hairclip. No character faces are needed for the two balls; keep those as complete separate play objects, not helmets.

items.name: purple-moon-half-mask
items.designBrief: An original silver-ivory open half-mask/crown with broad upturned cloud-wing cheek fins, a central large square violet gemstone, two smaller purple side gems and thin rising center spike. Hollow open face area, no wearer or anime face, tiny warm-gold rims.

items.name: pink-orchid-hair-bloom
items.designBrief: One large pink orchid-like flower hair ornament with orange-gold stamens, long flowing curved petals tapering down as a flower fairy ribbon, two subtle jade leaves. Preserve source's unusual long petal silhouette; complete tips, not a generic round rose.

items.name: rainbow-daisy-hairpin
items.designBrief: One cheerful daisy with golden round center, clear individual petals transitioning blue/turquoise at inner half to soft pink outer tips, small jade-green leaves and tiny gold bead accents. Multicolor on the petals only, no loose sparkles, no halo.

items.name: cloud-court-basketball
items.designBrief: A complete round orange-brown leather BASKETBALL with recognizable dark curved basketball seam pattern, soft painted leather texture and a very subtle gold cloud embossing. Tiny jade seam tag optional, no face, logo, arms or crown, no shadow.

items.name: jade-patch-football
items.designBrief: A complete round white/ivory and deep-teal FOOTBALL with recognizable stitched pentagon/hexagon patches, gentle hand-painted leather texture and thin warm-gold stitching. No face, logo, ears, character skin or shadow.

items.name: red-heart-feather-clip
items.designBrief: A single plump red enamel heart hairclip with tiny gold flower/star inset and one small ivory feather wing sweeping from upper right, slim jade/gold clip details. Compact heart silhouette and wing, no lettering, flag panel, UI frame or face.
